text:
Type: open pine shelving unit
Use: storing books, baskets and everyday things; living room, home office, hallway, storage room
Style: Scandinavian, rustic, minimalist
Materials: untreated solid pine, slim metal cross-brace wires
Colors: pale natural pine, warm blond wood, silver
Shape: two perforated ladder-style side frames with crossbars, four open shelves, X-shaped wire bracing at the back, utilitarian and open, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, honest, practical, warm
Goes with: white walls, woven baskets, linen, green plants; Scandinavian, rustic or cabin rooms, workrooms

product.name: IVAR
product.description: Untreated solid wood is a durable natural material which is even more hardwearing and easy to look after if you oil or wax the surface.
